what_i_found: Fright House is one investigation spread across twelve rooms that each change genre — street detective walk, four-floor platformer, library chase, barrel run, boss arena, rail-cart finale — without a break in the case. The field notes you actually stopped to take become the evidence that decides between two endings: the police arrest, or the bedroom that was always waiting. Switching mechanics every room turned out to be the horror pacing: the moment you learn a room's rules, the park changes them.
